parsed.why: No criminalisation or facility bans, but zero trans/LGBT anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse, official calls to exile trans people, unpunished anti-gay violence and gay-panic acquittals. Hostility with no remedy, elevated risk.

Criminalised extra-marital sex reaching same-sex conduct, provincial caning, presidential decree framing LGBTQ as security threats, mob attacks on trans women, police raids, and a trans traveller's death in custody.

Anti-discrimination and hate-crime laws on paper but unchecked police abuse of LGBT people, repeated unsanctioned attacks closing an LGBT centre, pride under heavy guard. Paper protections not shown to operate.

No criminalisation, court struck sodomy laws and read sex discrimination to cover gender identity; but no anti-discrimination or hate-crime recourse, no marker change, and no documented trans violence or policing.

No criminalisation, third-gender tradition and self-ID rulings, but implementation gaps, documented harassment of visibly trans people in public and state institutions, conversion therapy, and recent top-level homophobic rhetoric.
